Container.Name: KOReaderPyLink
Container.Overview: This is a simple implementation of the KOReader (https://github.com/koreader/koreader) position sync server for self-hosting at home which has docker support. This is a modified fork of b1n4ryj4n/koreader-sync with some additional logging and slightly modified endpoints.
Container.DonateText: Like this template? Please consider donating :)

Config.Name: DB Path
Config.Description: Remove this path if you don't want a persistant db.

Config.Name: RECEIVE_RANDOM_DEVICE_ID
Config.Description: Set it true to retrieve always a random device id to force a progress sync. This is usefull if you only sync your progress from one device and usually delete the *.sdr files with some cleaning tools.

Config.Name: OPEN_REGISTRATIONS
Config.Description: Enable/disable new registrations to the server. Useful if you want to run a private server for a few users, although it doesn't necessarily improve security by itself. Set to True (enabled) by default.
